title: Buy-drought same-candidate comparison: crypto A vs V4, US A vs V4, KR ATR/rebound entry vs cash
question: On the same pre-registered candidates, does the alternative rule (V4 deep_limit upper 0% for crypto and US; ATR or rebound entry for KR) beat cash at equal notional budget after costs? First window per market is feasibility only (PREREG section 10).

code_sha.pending: collector and evaluator are not built; sealed per PREREG section 14

cost_table_sha256.pending: per-market cost table sealed at seal (PREREG 2.4)

features.name: support_levels
features.available_at: levels computed from daily bars closed before t

features.name: current_price
features.available_at: quote as-of <= t, stored with its as-of; crypto: last complete Upbit 1m bar before t, stale > 15 min is UNKNOWN_INPUT

features.name: rsi14
features.available_at: Wilder RSI on bars closed before t

features.name: upside_pct
features.available_at: consensus (KR/US) or session forecast target (crypto) recorded at t

features.name: atr14_kr
features.available_at: Wilder ATR14 through the last KRX daily bar closed before t (E3)

labels.name: E1_crypto_R_t_plus_120h
labels.definition: net-of-cost return of the arm vs B_m at floor_minute(t)+120h (1m close of [T_eval-1m, T_eval))

labels.name: E2_us_R_D0_plus_20
labels.definition: net-of-cost return of the arm vs B_m at the D0+20 XNYS regular close

labels.name: E3_kr_R_D0_plus_5
labels.definition: net-of-cost return of the rule vs cash at the D0+5 KRX close

splits.scheme: prospective forward shadow; no historical fitting. Feasibility window per market, then a newly sealed confirmation epoch that excludes feasibility data (PREREG section 10).

period.pending: fixed at seal: E1 28x24h from the next UTC hour, E2 60 XNYS sessions, E3 60 KRX sessions; never extended

test.exposure_audit: not applicable: every evaluated decision is made after the seal
test.seal_rule: confirmation epoch is a new manifest version sealed after the feasibility window closes

candidate_policies.description: crypto: current regular-discovery buy gate reproduced deterministically (PREREG 2.2)
crypto: A with buy.deep_limit_pct_range upper bound -3% -> 0% only (V4)
US: current gate A; separate epoch from ROB-1391
US: A with the V4 upper bound change only
KR: limit DAY at tick_floor(C - 0.5*ATR14) on D0
KR: first hourly close above H by 14:00 KST, cap tick_floor(C_h + 0.1*ATR14), DAY
KR: A anchor limit DAY on D0 (secondary comparison only)
no entry; 0% cash return (parking-yield sensitivity separate)

cost_table.pending: per-market fee/tax/slippage table from account fill ratios, sealed at seal; no net verdict while PENDING_COST_TABLE

fill_models: conservative: 1m low <= P - 1 tick, qty <= floor(1% of minute volume), price = P
optimistic: 1m low <= P, no quantity cap (sensitivity)
strict (E2 sensitivity): conservative plus valid ask <= P observed inside the minute window

tuning_budget.search: none: every rule is fixed by the pre-registration; no parameter is tuned on outcomes

seeds.pending: bootstrap seed sealed at seal (10,000 resamples, symbol-cluster and date-block)

metrics.primary: E1/E2: H_cash = mean over incremental parents I of (R_B - R_cash); E3: mu_r = mean over eligible parents of (R_r - R_cash); net of costs at the primary horizon
secondary: H_A = mean over I of (R_B - R_A), success condition only
auxiliary horizons: crypto t+480h, US/KR D0+20 and post-fill markouts

delta_min.pending: draft +1.0pp of candidate budget; operator fixes per market at seal (PREREG 15-3)

stopping_rules: stop new registrations on any look-ahead input (as-of > t) or fill/trigger judged on bars before s
stop on a duplicate parent key with different content
stop on any arm exceeding B_m including costs
stop if collection or evaluation can reach an order, proposal, watch or ledger write path
stop on a mismatch of deployed policy hash, code SHA, calendar or sealed constants
stop on evaluator invariant breach (A_only observed, observable_hours=0 with not_triggered, non-deterministic re-classification)
a merged policy change ends the epoch (STOPPED_BY_POLICY_CHANGE); no automatic resume
the feasibility window is never extended
